description: Picks a cheaper or stronger Claude model per Spec Kit spec, based on its complexity.
config.mode: Which model each spec complexity level gets.
config.mode.saver: Saver: Simple → Haiku, Medium → Haiku, Complex → Sonnet
config.mode.balanced: Balanced: Simple → Haiku, Medium → Sonnet, Complex → Opus
config.mode.quality: Quality: Simple → Sonnet, Medium → Opus, Complex → Opus
config.thresholds.medium: Score (0–100) from which a spec counts as **medium**. Must be lower than the complex threshold.
config.thresholds.complex: Score (0–100) from which a spec counts as **complex**.
config.borderlineMargin: A score this many points below a threshold is rounded up to the stronger model.
config.writingModel.followMode: Write specs (specify, clarify) with the mode's model (Saver → Haiku, Balanced → Sonnet, Quality → Opus) instead of always Sonnet.
command.cleanClaudeSettings: Remove Tokenomist from Claude Code Settings
config.mode.custom: Custom: your own Claude model per level (tokenomist.custom.*); empty cells use Balanced
config.custom.simple: Custom mode: model for **simple** specs, e.g. `haiku` or `claude-haiku-4-5`. Empty = Balanced (Haiku).
config.custom.medium: Custom mode: model for **medium** specs, e.g. `sonnet` or `opusplan`. Empty = Balanced (Sonnet).
config.custom.complex: Custom mode: model for **complex** specs, e.g. `opus` or `opus[1m]`. Empty = Balanced (Opus).
config.custom.writing: Custom mode: model while the spec is written (specify, clarify). Empty = Sonnet.
config.custom.invalid: Enter a Claude model value such as opus, opus[1m], opusplan or claude-opus-5-5, or leave it empty.
config.automation: Whether Tokenomist manages models without asking.
config.automation.auto: Automatic: lock the recommended model when the plan starts and move commands to a new conversation (with the command ready) without asking.
config.automation.ask: Ask: show a dialog before locking, switching conversations and finishing.
config.conversation: How Spec Kit commands get their model.
config.conversation.same: Same conversation: Tokenomist writes the model into the Spec Kit command definitions (hidden from git while changed), so every command runs with the right model in your current conversation.
config.conversation.new: New conversation: Tokenomist sets Claude Code's model and moves commands to a new conversation when needed.
